title: Boba Milk Tea

ingredientGroups.title: Boba
items: ¼ cup 2:1 brown sugar simple syrup

steps: Heat 1 liter water to 185°F. Add the tea leaves and steep for 10 minutes; strain and chill.
Bring 10 cups water to a boil in a large pot. Gently swirl the water and slowly add the boba so they do not stick to the bottom.
When most of the boba float, reduce the heat to medium and simmer covered for 8 minutes. Turn off the heat; the source then says to simmer for an additional 8 minutes.
Transfer the boba to a bowl of cold water. After 20 seconds, transfer to a storage container and add ¼ cup 2:1 brown sugar simple syrup.
For each drink, combine ½ cup tea concentrate, 3 Tbsp evaporated milk, 2 Tbsp simple syrup, ¼ cup boba and ½ cup ice. Stir.
reviewFlags: The source is a draft. Confirm whether the boba should rest or continue simmering during the 8 minutes after the heat is turned off, and whether the assembly syrup is the brown sugar syrup.
